dispatch.comment: Numbers of the hand-written theorems `enter`, `enterShort`, `enterOther` (Enter.lean): gas of the prelude, gas of one table entry, the memory words after the prelude; explicit_size: a successful run says nothing of the size of the call data (payable fallback), so `ok_<fn>` takes `4 <= size` as a hypothesis.

paths.comment: memory_lemmas named: the block lemmas use the lemmas named after the offset of the free memory pointer (memW_ext96, memW_write96, memW_read96, size_memW4) where they apply, as the first build of this token did; without the key the lemmas for any aligned word are used (memW_set, memW_readWord, size_memWn).

balanceOf.doc: balanceOf(a): no value; returns `balanceOf[a]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

allowance.doc: allowance(owner, spender): no value; returns `allowance[owner][spender]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

decimals.doc: decimals(): no value; returns the low byte of slot 2; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

deposit.doc: deposit() credits the value of the message to the caller `dst`, with any value and any call data it accepts. Success needs a frame that may write. Then: returns nothing; `balanceOf[dst]` is the old word plus the value modulo 2^256 (the bytecode does not check the addition); every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Deposit(dst, value).
ensures: ∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {dst} 3 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

fallbackShort.doc: The fallback, for call data shorter than 4 bytes, credits the value of the message to the caller `dst`, with any value and any call data it accepts. Success needs a frame that may write. Then: returns nothing; `balanceOf[dst]` is the old word plus the value modulo 2^256 (the bytecode does not check the addition); every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Deposit(dst, value).
ensures: ∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {dst} 3 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

fallbackOther.doc: The fallback, for a selector that is no function of the contract, credits the value of the message to the caller `dst`, with any value and any call data it accepts. Success needs a frame that may write. Then: returns nothing; `balanceOf[dst]` is the old word plus the value modulo 2^256 (the bytecode does not check the addition); every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Deposit(dst, value).
ensures: ∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {dst} 3 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

approve.doc: approve(guy, wad) from the caller `src`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write. Then: returns 1; `allowance[src][guy]` is `wad`; every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Approval(src, guy, wad).
ensures: ∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {guy} (mapSlot {src} 4) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

transfer.doc: transfer(dst, wad) from the caller `src`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, `wad <= balanceOf[src]`. Then: returns 1; `balanceOf[src]` is the old word minus `wad` and `balanceOf[dst]` the old word plus `wad` modulo 2^256 (the bytecode does not check the addition; when `dst = src` the balance is unchanged); every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Transfer(src, dst, wad).
ensures: {dst} ≠ {src} → (balance message s.state {src}).toNat = (balance message state {src}).toNat - {wad}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {dst}).toNat = ((balance message state {dst}).toNat + {wad}.toNat) % 2 ^ 256
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {src} 3 → k ≠ mapSlot {dst} 3 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

transferFrom.doc: transferFrom(src, dst, wad) by the caller `guy`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, `wad <= balanceOf[src]`, and, when `src` is not `guy` and `allowance[src][guy]` is not 2^256 - 1, `wad <= allowance[src][guy]`. Then: returns 1; the balances move as in transfer; in that same case the allowance is the old word minus `wad`, and otherwise it is unchanged; every other slot keeps its word; exactly one log, Transfer(src, dst, wad).
ensures: {dst} ≠ {src} → (balance message s.state {src}).toNat = (balance message state {src}).toNat - {wad}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {dst}).toNat = ((balance message state {dst}).toNat + {wad}.toNat) % 2 ^ 256
{src} ≠ {guy} → allowance message state {src} {guy} ≠ {max} → (allowance message s.state {src} {guy}).toNat = (allowance message state {src} {guy}).toNat - {wad}.toNat
{src} = {guy} → allowance message s.state {src} {guy} = allowance message state {src} {guy}
allowance message state {src} {guy} = {max} → allowance message s.state {src} {guy} = allowance message state {src} {guy}
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {src} 3 → k ≠ mapSlot {dst} 3 → k ≠ mapSlot {guy} (mapSlot {src} 4) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

sanity.comment: The argument words of the witness call of each function (scripts/gen_sanity.py): address arguments not 0, amounts 0. transferFrom has three success paths: its witnesses are in Sanity/Moves.lean, by hand.

axioms.comment: names: hand-written theorems checked before the generated ones; after: theorems of files that import the generated ones; imports: the modules Test/Axioms.lean imports; declared_only: leave out a generated name that no Lean file declares.
